# Pinned build + dist-check toolchain for release.yml.
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. release.yml ran `python -m pip install --upgrade build`
# — not merely an unbounded floor but an instruction to take the newest thing
# on the index, on the one workflow whose output is the artefact a customer
# installs. The wheels for reeflex-claude / reeflex-holds / reeflex-mcp are
# built by whatever `build` happened to be published that morning.
#
# BOUND, justified by the surface release.yml uses: `python -m build --outdir
# <dir> <project>`, i.e. the PEP 517 front-end CLI. That CLI is the 1.x
# interface (latest 1.6.0, 2026-08-27); a 2.0 would be free to change it.
#
# NOTE, said plainly: release.yml runs only on a tag push, so this pin is NOT
# exercised by any PR's CI. It is bounded on reasoning, and the first tag cut
# after it lands is what proves it. Both entries below were exercised by hand
# on the devbox against this tree's four dists before they landed (dev-1 round
# 061): `python -m build` produced all four, `twine check --strict` PASSED on
# all eight files.
build>=1.2,<2

# `twine check --strict` in release.yml's `verify-dist` job. METADATA is the
# one class of defect that survives a green build and a green suite and then
# renders as raw text on the project page a customer reads; `--strict` makes a
# warning an error. Bounded by the surface used: the `check` subcommand and its
# `--strict` flag, stable across 5.x and 6.x (latest 6.2.0). `upload` is NOT
# used — publishing is `pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish` over OIDC, and no PyPI
# credential exists in this repo for twine to find.
twine>=5,<7
